description: Public-language atomic skill candidates for DuoFlow System2 skill retrieval. These entries are semantic prompts, not trained policies.

kind_policy.composite: Derived by skill_library.py for multi-operation candidates such as handover, bimanual placement, stacking, sorting, and scan-with-tool.
kind_policy.primitive: All other entries are single semantic action candidates after the planning/composite sets are removed.

skills.prompt: Inspect the current camera views for the task workspace.
skills.preconditions: A current observation is available.
skills.postconditions: Relevant visible objects and regions are described in public language.

skills.prompt: Locate the target object {object} in the current observation.
skills.preconditions: The target label is given in the instruction.
skills.postconditions: A visible instance of the target is selected by description.

skills.prompt: Locate the destination {target} for {object}.
skills.preconditions: The object and destination are named by the instruction.
skills.postconditions: The destination region is selected from the observation.

skills.prompt: Select the arm that can manipulate {object} while keeping the instruction constraint in view.
skills.preconditions: The object is visible and arm choice is not fixed by a prior skill.
skills.postconditions: One arm is selected in public language.

skills.prompt: Choose the reachable side of {object} for the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is visible and the requested arm is available.
skills.postconditions: An approach side is selected from the camera view.

skills.prompt: Refresh the observation and reassess {object} after the preceding action.
skills.preconditions: A preceding action has produced a new observation.
skills.postconditions: The next decision uses the refreshed public observation.

skills.prompt: Track the visible target {object} while it is being moved.
skills.preconditions: The target remains visible during movement.
skills.postconditions: The target is referred to consistently by its current visible appearance.

skills.prompt: Move {object} toward the visible center of the workspace.
skills.preconditions: The object is held or can be moved by the selected arm.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned near the visible workspace center.

skills.prompt: Approach {object} with the {arm} arm while keeping the gripper clear of other objects.
skills.preconditions: The object is visible and the arm is free.
skills.postconditions: The gripper is near the object without claiming contact.

skills.prompt: Approach the handle of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: A handle is visible on the object.
skills.postconditions: The gripper is positioned near the handle.

skills.prompt: Approach the visible surface {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The destination surface is visible.
skills.postconditions: The gripper or held object is near the destination surface.

skills.prompt: Approach the opening of {target} with {object} held by the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is held and the container opening is visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is near the container opening.

skills.prompt: Reach toward {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is visible and the arm is free.
skills.postconditions: The gripper reaches the object approach region.

skills.prompt: Reach toward the handle of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The handle is visible.
skills.postconditions: The gripper reaches the handle approach region.

skills.prompt: Reach above the top surface of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The top surface is visible.
skills.postconditions: The gripper is above the object without claiming a grasp.

skills.prompt: Reach beside {object} from the visible approach side with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: A side approach is visible.
skills.postconditions: The gripper is beside the object.

skills.prompt: Align the {arm} gripper over {object} before grasping.
skills.preconditions: The object is visible and reachable.
skills.postconditions: The gripper is visually aligned above the object.

skills.prompt: Align the {arm} gripper with the handle of {object}.
skills.preconditions: The handle is visible.
skills.postconditions: The gripper is visually aligned with the handle.

skills.prompt: Align {object} with the visible destination {target}.
skills.preconditions: The object and destination are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is visually aligned with the destination.

skills.prompt: Rotate {object} until its required orientation relative to {target} is visually aligned.
skills.preconditions: The orientation requirement is stated by the instruction.
skills.postconditions: The requested orientation is visually aligned.

skills.prompt: Keep {object} upright while preparing or carrying it with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object has a visible upright requirement.
skills.postconditions: The object remains visually head-up.

skills.prompt: Orient {object} horizontally as requested, using the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and horizontal requirement are visible or stated.
skills.postconditions: The object is visually horizontal.

skills.prompt: Orient {object} so its designated tip or front faces left.
skills.preconditions: The instruction specifies a left-facing orientation.
skills.postconditions: The designated side visibly faces left.

skills.prompt: Orient {object} so its marked face points toward the robot.
skills.preconditions: The instruction specifies a robot-facing orientation.
skills.postconditions: The marked face visibly points toward the robot.

skills.prompt: Grasp {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is visible and the gripper is aligned.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts to hold the object while maintaining the public task constraint.

skills.prompt: Grasp the handle of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The handle is visible and the gripper is aligned.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts to hold the handle.

skills.prompt: Grasp the top region of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The top region is visible and reachable.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a top grasp.

skills.prompt: Grasp the side of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The side approach is visible and reachable.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a side grasp.

skills.prompt: Use a careful grasp to pick up the small object {object} with {arm}.
skills.preconditions: The small object is visible.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a stable small-object grasp.

skills.prompt: Use a broad grasp to pick up the large object {object} with {arm}.
skills.preconditions: The large object is visible and reachable.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a stable large-object grasp.

skills.prompt: Use the left arm to grasp {object}.
skills.preconditions: The instruction or current plan assigns the object to the left arm.
skills.postconditions: The left arm attempts to hold the object.

skills.prompt: Use the right arm to grasp {object}.
skills.preconditions: The instruction or current plan assigns the object to the right arm.
skills.postconditions: The right arm attempts to hold the object.

skills.prompt: Use both arms to grasp {object} while keeping the grip coordinated.
skills.preconditions: The object is large or the instruction explicitly requires both arms.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt a coordinated hold.

skills.prompt: Pinch {object} with the {arm} arm using a precise grasp.
skills.preconditions: The object is small enough for a precise grasp.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a precise pinch hold.

skills.prompt: Stabilize the grasp on {object} with the {arm} arm before moving.
skills.preconditions: The arm has just attempted to grasp the object.
skills.postconditions: The grasp is visually checked and held steady.

skills.prompt: Maintain the {arm} arm grasp on {object} during the next movement.
skills.preconditions: The object is being held by the specified arm.
skills.postconditions: The arm keeps the object in its grasp while moving.

skills.prompt: Regrasp {object} with the {arm} arm to satisfy the next manipulation direction.
skills.preconditions: The current grasp is unsuitable for the stated reason.
skills.postconditions: A new grasp orientation is attempted.

skills.prompt: Grasp the pair {objects} with both arms, one item per arm.
skills.preconditions: Two distinct target items are visible.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt separate holds.

skills.prompt: Grasp {left_object} with the left arm and {right_object} with the right arm.
skills.preconditions: Both distinct objects are visible and reachable.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt their assigned holds.

skills.prompt: Grasp the tool {tool} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The tool is visible and reachable.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts to hold the tool.

skills.prompt: Lift {object} from the table with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is grasped or the instruction permits a direct lift.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts to raise the object above the table.

skills.prompt: Lift {object} while keeping it upright with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object has a head-up or upright constraint.
skills.postconditions: The object is raised while visually remaining upright.

skills.prompt: Use both arms to lift {object} together.
skills.preconditions: The instruction requires both arms or the object needs two-arm support.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt to raise the object together.

skills.prompt: Lift the tool {tool} with the {arm} arm for the next operation.
skills.preconditions: The tool is grasped or reachable.
skills.postconditions: The tool is raised into an operating position.

skills.prompt: Hold {object} steady with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is grasped.
skills.postconditions: The arm maintains a steady hold.

skills.prompt: Stabilize {object} with the {arm} arm while preserving its required orientation.
skills.preconditions: The object is held and has an orientation requirement.
skills.postconditions: The held object is visually stabilized.

skills.prompt: Carry {object} toward {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is held and the target is visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is moved toward the target.

skills.prompt: Move {object} beside {reference} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: Both objects are visible and the first is held.
skills.postconditions: The object is moved to a beside relationship.

skills.prompt: Move {object} farther outward from the table with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The instruction requires outward motion and the object is held.
skills.postconditions: The object is moved outward while remaining visible.

skills.prompt: Move {object} to the visible center of the table with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is held or can be moved.
skills.postconditions: The object is near the visible table center.

skills.prompt: Move {object} toward the left side of {reference} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and reference are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is moved toward the left-side relation.

skills.prompt: Move {object} toward the right side of {reference} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and reference are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is moved toward the right-side relation.

skills.prompt: Carry {objects} together toward {target} using both arms.
skills.preconditions: Two objects are held, one per arm.
skills.postconditions: Both objects move toward the target together.

skills.prompt: Carry the container {container} with the {arm} arm toward {target}.
skills.preconditions: The container is grasped and the target is visible.
skills.postconditions: The container is moved toward the target.

skills.prompt: Move {object} away from the current placement with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The instruction requires a separating movement.
skills.postconditions: The object is visibly farther from the prior region.

skills.prompt: Move {object} into the visible workspace while keeping it under control with {arm}.
skills.preconditions: The object is reachable and the workspace is visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is inside the intended workspace region.

skills.prompt: Place {object} onto the surface {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is held and the surface is visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the surface before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} inside the container {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and container opening are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned inside the container before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} on the colored mat {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and mat are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the mat before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} on the pad {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and pad are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the pad before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} onto the plate {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and plate are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the plate before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} onto the scale {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and scale are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the scale before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} onto the stand {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and stand are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the stand before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} onto the coaster {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object and coaster are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the coaster before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} onto the phone stand {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The phone and stand are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned on the phone stand before release.

skills.prompt: Place {objects} into {target}, keeping the specified orientation.
skills.preconditions: The shoes and shoebox are visible.
skills.postconditions: The shoes are positioned inside the shoebox before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} inside the open drawer {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The drawer is visibly open and the object is held.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned inside the drawer before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} on top of {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: Both objects are visible and the first is held.
skills.postconditions: The first object is positioned above the second before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} beside {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: Both objects are visible and the first is held.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned beside the target before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} to the left of {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: Both objects are visible and the first is held.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned left of the target before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} to the right of {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: Both objects are visible and the first is held.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned right of the target before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} in the requested order within the row {target}.
skills.preconditions: The row and ordering rule are stated or visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned at its requested row location before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} at the visible center of {target}.
skills.preconditions: The object and target center are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned near the target center before release.

skills.prompt: Place {object} on {target} while preserving orientation: {orientation}.
skills.preconditions: The object, target, and orientation rule are visible or stated.
skills.postconditions: The object is positioned with the requested orientation before release.

skills.prompt: Release {object} from the {arm} arm after positioning it.
skills.preconditions: The object is held and positioned over its target.
skills.postconditions: The gripper opens and the object is no longer intentionally held.

skills.prompt: Release {object} only after visually confirming alignment with {target}.
skills.preconditions: The object is held near its target.
skills.postconditions: Release is attempted after the public alignment check.

skills.prompt: Release {object} inside {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is held over the visible interior of the target.
skills.postconditions: The object is released inside the target region.

skills.prompt: Release {object} onto the visible surface {target} with {arm}.
skills.preconditions: The object is held over the target surface.
skills.postconditions: The object is released onto the target surface.

skills.prompt: Grasp the handle of {object} with {arm} and pull it open.
skills.preconditions: The handle and opening direction are visible.
skills.postconditions: The object is pulled toward an open configuration.

skills.prompt: Pull the door of {object} open with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The door and pull direction are visible.
skills.postconditions: The door is moved toward an open configuration.

skills.prompt: Open the laptop {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The laptop opening edge is visible.
skills.postconditions: The laptop is moved toward an open configuration.

skills.prompt: Open the drawer of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The drawer handle or front edge is visible.
skills.postconditions: The drawer is moved toward an open configuration.

skills.prompt: Press the button on {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The button is visible.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a downward press on the button.

skills.prompt: Use the held tool {tool} to strike {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The tool is held and the target is visible.
skills.postconditions: The tool is moved toward the target in a controlled striking motion.

skills.prompt: Press or click the switch {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The switch is visible.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts the requested switch activation.

skills.prompt: Press the top of stapler {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The stapler is visible and the top surface is reachable.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a downward stapler press.

skills.prompt: Press the top center of bell {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The bell top center is visible.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a top-center bell press.

skills.prompt: Press the center of the top button on alarm clock {object} with {arm}.
skills.preconditions: The alarm clock top button is visible.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a top-button press.

skills.prompt: Click the visible center of {object} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The click target is visible.
skills.postconditions: The arm attempts a centered click.

skills.prompt: Press stamp {tool} onto the specified color mat {target} with {arm}.
skills.preconditions: The stamp and mat are visible and the tool is held.
skills.postconditions: The stamp is pressed toward the mat.

skills.prompt: Rotate {object} with the {arm} arm according to the instruction.
skills.preconditions: The object is held or directly manipulable.
skills.postconditions: The object is rotated toward the requested direction.

skills.prompt: Rotate {object} so its marked face points toward the robot.
skills.preconditions: The object has a marked or task-relevant face.
skills.postconditions: The marked face is visually oriented toward the robot.

skills.prompt: Shake {object} vertically with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is held and the task requests shaking.
skills.postconditions: The object is moved in a vertical shaking pattern.

skills.prompt: Shake {object} horizontally with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The object is held and the task requests horizontal shaking.
skills.postconditions: The object is moved in a horizontal shaking pattern.

skills.prompt: Tilt {container} and pour its contents into {target} with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The container and target are visible and the container is held.
skills.postconditions: The container is tilted toward the target.

skills.prompt: Move {container} above the opening of {target} before pouring.
skills.preconditions: The container is held and the target opening is visible.
skills.postconditions: The container is positioned above the target opening.

skills.prompt: Set {container} down on the visible table region with the {arm} arm.
skills.preconditions: The container is held and a clear table region is visible.
skills.postconditions: The container is positioned on the table before release.

skills.prompt: Close the {arm} gripper around {object}.
skills.preconditions: The gripper is aligned with the object.
skills.postconditions: The gripper attempts to close around the object.

skills.prompt: Open the {arm} gripper to release {object}.
skills.preconditions: The arm is holding or positioned over the object.
skills.postconditions: The gripper attempts to open.

skills.prompt: Transfer {object} from the left arm to the right arm.
skills.preconditions: The left arm holds the object and the right arm is available.
skills.postconditions: The right arm attempts to take the object.

skills.prompt: Transfer {object} from the right arm to the left arm.
skills.preconditions: The right arm holds the object and the left arm is available.
skills.postconditions: The left arm attempts to take the object.

skills.prompt: Hand {object} from the current arm to the other available arm.
skills.preconditions: The source arm holds the object and the target arm is available.
skills.postconditions: The target arm attempts to take the object.

skills.prompt: Move {object} into the {target_arm} arm while preserving its orientation.
skills.preconditions: The object is held by the opposite arm.
skills.postconditions: The target arm attempts a coordinated transfer.

skills.prompt: Pick up {left_object} with the left arm and {right_object} with the right arm together.
skills.preconditions: Both target objects are visible and separately reachable.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt simultaneous pickup.

skills.prompt: Place {left_object} and {right_object} into {target} using both arms.
skills.preconditions: Both objects are held and the target is visible.
skills.postconditions: Both objects are positioned in the target before release.

skills.prompt: Hold {container} with both arms while keeping it stable.
skills.preconditions: The container is visible and requires two-arm support.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt a stable container hold.

skills.prompt: Use the {support_arm} arm to stabilize {object} while the {active_arm} arm manipulates it.
skills.preconditions: Both arms are available and the object needs support.
skills.postconditions: One arm supports while the other performs the active manipulation.

skills.prompt: Coordinate both arms to place {object} into {target}.
skills.preconditions: The object is large or the instruction requires coordinated placement.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt to position the object at the target.

skills.prompt: Use scanner {tool} to scan {object} while maintaining the required two-arm arrangement.
skills.preconditions: The scanner and object are visible and separately held or reachable.
skills.postconditions: The scanner is moved toward the object for a scan.

skills.prompt: Pick up tool {tool} with one arm and {object} with the other arm.
skills.preconditions: Both items are visible and separately reachable.
skills.postconditions: Both arms attempt their assigned holds.

skills.prompt: Move all listed objects {objects} into {target} using available arms.
skills.preconditions: All listed objects and the target are visible.
skills.postconditions: Each object is positioned toward the target in a public-language plan.

skills.prompt: Place {top_object} on top of {bottom_object} to form a two-item stack.
skills.preconditions: Both objects are visible and the top object can be held.
skills.postconditions: The top object is positioned above the bottom object before release.

skills.prompt: Build a three-item stack by placing {middle_object} on {bottom_object}, then {top_object} on {middle_object}.
skills.preconditions: All three objects are visible and the instruction specifies the order.
skills.postconditions: A three-item stack is proposed through public-language subgoals.

skills.prompt: Arrange {objects} from left to right according to the color order {order}.
skills.preconditions: The objects and color ordering rule are visible or stated.
skills.postconditions: The next placement candidate follows the stated color order.

skills.prompt: Arrange {objects} from left to right according to size order {order}.
skills.preconditions: The objects and size ordering rule are visible or stated.
skills.postconditions: The next placement candidate follows the stated size order.

skills.prompt: Place {object} in relation {relation} to {reference}.
skills.preconditions: The object and reference are visible.
skills.postconditions: The requested spatial relation is targeted before release.

skills.prompt: Check from the current camera views whether {object} satisfies the visible task relation {relation}.
skills.preconditions: A candidate action has just finished and a new observation is available.
skills.postconditions: A public-language verification result is produced without reading simulator flags.
